plan: A brawler jungler who charges at her target and knocks it up with nothing able to stop her.
aSurveiller: Her R (Cease and Desist). She charges at you and knocks you up: nothing stops her, regroup with your team.
contrer: Stay near your allies: her R is made to isolate a target.
Dodge her charged Q: it knocks you back.
Keep crowd control for after her R.
faiblesses: Her Q is easy to see coming.

sorts.E: Punch that goes through her target.
sorts.R: Charges at an enemy and knocks them up.

momentFort: Strong from level 3 in duels and ganks thanks to her Q. At level 6, her unstoppable R makes her even more dangerous.
